method: Whole file.c/file.h reads with Git blob and SHA256 verification.
findings: RmFile captures initial stat size and floating mtime; device/inode stored in path trie node. Model has no retained ctime field or open-file descriptor in these files. This constrains available later mutation checks without proving whole-program behavior.
Path reconstruction uses fixed PATH_MAX buffers and void wrapper; trie truncation/error handling requires pathtricia implementation review.
path_index unsigned input is stored guint16; link and outer-link counts gint16, depth gint16. Range validation must be checked in callers before large-count conclusions.

Clamped comparison uses start/end offset or file-size factors, explicitly computes slice size and rejects nonempty file with empty slice. Partial equality is a configured behavior and should not be adopted as whole-file proof.
Lint-type string lookup clamps type to array element count, not last valid index. For value at/above count it selects one-past-end; caller reachability and runtime reproduction remain untested.
rm_file_copy calls rm_digest_copy(file->digest) without nullable guard, even though new model digest may be NULL. Valid copy call sites still require inspection.
Hardlink/cluster operations maintain shared queues and count all bundled paths; mutation/refcount atomicity does not make shared queue mutation automatically thread-safe.
limits: Static model audit only; no new runtime tests or rrrah source edits.
Traverse/path-trie/copy callers remain to inspect. Native pHash deferred; global full repository count150/500.
